title: Schoolworld
content: Does anyone else go to schoolworld? For many years I had dreams where I was back in school. It started with middle school, and as the years went by (I mean real life years), I'd get older and older in schoolworld, until eventually I graduated from high school in these dreams. Now I'm on collegeworld. In collegeworld, my favorite place to visit is the library. It has so many floors, and the ceilings are really high and made of glass like you'd see in a greenhouse or some kind of arboretum. My least favorite place in collegeworld is the bathroom, which is just a bunch of overflowing shitfilled stalls with either no door or a broken door. Have you been there too?
